blurb:
This is the only place for aerial dancing over water from a sailboat in USA where you have many choices of aerial apparatuses; animals around for a warm tropical atmosphere, friendly vibes, and raw footage captured for an unforgettable lasting memory. Suspended above sparkling waters, this aerial arts experience invites participants of all ages to explore their creativity and physical abilities. Each session features three signature apparatuses: Aerial Anchor, Aerial Umbrella, and Aerial Net, with the option to select a fourth apparatus per group from a variety such as Flying Pole, Flying Lollipop, Silks, MoonLyra, Lyra, Trapeze, Bungee.

Set against the backdrop of a sunset bay, island, or beach, this unique activity promises unforgettable moments filled with laughter and fun. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced aerialist, this is a thrilling Miami bucket list aerial play adventure. Raw video footage provided via air drop after session; or iCloud link for later downloads
